verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents an `md` output mode "optimized for LLMs and AI agents" that works with every API at "roughly half the tokens" of JSON. A field-selection parameter trims payload size, and the docs explicitly pitch feeding search data into RAG pipelines. However, results are Google SERP snippets in their native ordering, with no evidenced LLM-oriented relevance ranking, token-budget sizing or chunking controls, and no full-page content extraction for context. Missing for 10: LLM-specific ranking/reranking, token-budget or chunk-size controls, page-content extraction for grounding, independent or hands-on corroboration of RAG suitability.
